description: The audio worker (Silero, CAM++, ReDimNet) always runs WASM but loads onnxruntime-web/webgpu asyncify (packages/provider-local/src/ort-env.ts). Switch it to onnxruntime-web (ort-wasm-simd-threaded.wasm). For the asr worker, transformers.js 4.2 imports onnxruntime-web/webgpu statically (src/backends/onnx.js), so build a second asr worker entry with a Vite alias to the plain wasm bundle and pick the worker by selected target (LocalEngines workerFactory / ensureAsr WebGPU->WASM fallback must switch worker). WebGPU sessions keep asyncify. Evidence (jsc shell, 1 thread): q4 decoder create 0.6 s vs 5.1 s, first 2 s encoder run 0.17 s vs 8.0 s, steady RTF 0.07 vs 0.12. Verify in simulator against the A0 baseline; keep catalog/lock integrity unchanged.

comments.text: Landed (jj rev 'Plain ORT WASM build for CPU-only sessions'). Per-worker ORT flavor via worker name; tjs injected via Symbol.for('onnxruntime') + pnpm patch (patches/@huggingface__transformers@4.2.0.patch) since tjs 4.2 leaves supportedDevices empty for injected runtimes. Simulator two_cities: Moonshine load 43.2->4.0 s, CAM++ 3.1->0.5 s, STT 2037->950 ms/call, VAD RTF 0.32->0.018, embed 513->87 ms/window, final lag p50 2.53->1.26 s, p95 9.02->3.22 s, interim calls 2->24, max level 1->0, first caption 5.45->3.33 s. Node harness unchanged (V8). Production build bundles both builds.

title: Use the plain (non-asyncify) ORT WASM build for CPU-only sessions
